meta.title: Chinese serif text
meta.description: Contributes a Chinese serif font family (Dsh CJK Serif) to Settings → Fonts → Text font. When the family is in the text font list, Chinese text uses a serif face while Latin text and code keep their fonts. The plugin does not override the theme: its switch writes the same text-font setting the font field edits, so other font choices keep working. Requires an installed CJK serif font.
